name: firecrawl
description: Firecrawl web data skills for Codex: search, scrape, crawl, map, interact, parse, and agent workflows via the Firecrawl CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Search, scrape, and crawl the web with Firecrawl
interface.longDescription: Bundle of Firecrawl CLI workflow skills for live web research and extraction in Codex. This plugin is skills-only for Codex directory review; MCP and ChatGPT app integration can be added after the app review path is complete. Requires Firecrawl CLI authentication or a Firecrawl API key from firecrawl.dev.
defaultPrompt: Use Firecrawl to search the web for the latest release notes on Next.js App Router and summarize.
Use Firecrawl to scrape https://docs.firecrawl.dev and list the top-level doc sections.
